purpose: Observed initializer progress only. Never target/point/control/accepted-prefix/resource authority. All fields start empty/zero in the caller; no expected recipe count shortcut.

fields.factory_returned: Set only by cold caller AFTER captured factory and mandatory postguard return.
fields.factory_capture_seconds: Actual inclusive factory capture preparation until final metadata, if available; no whole-stage attribution.
fields.boundary_entries: Actual guarded callback entries, counted after original clock identity check; a later rejection may prevent completion.
fields.boundary_returns: Completed local guard work; final metadata deadline rejection removes its count. It is not a driver recipe completion count.
fields.last_started_recipe_index: Actual callback index input, may be unvalidated on a failed boundary.
fields.last_returned_boundary_recipe_index: Last local guard work passing all pre/post body checks; if its final metadata deadline fails it is supplemental rejected work only.
fields.completed_recipe_comparisons_observed: Exact len(primitives) in the genuine original initializer frame after relevant class/frame identity checks; list append follows original complete witness/port/preimage comparisons. Lower bound only until caller constructor returns.
fields.completed_boundary_inclusive_seconds: Inclusive elapsed original native clock for completed guard bodies, including their initial direct checks; aborted bodies before completion are omitted. A final metadata-time rejected body can remain included. Not total guard cost or nonoverlapping phase sum.
fields.constructor_returned: Set only after actual original complete constructor plus mandatory cold caller postguard returns.
fields.constructor_recipe_interfaces: Literal len(observer.primitives) only after that return. None on failure; no authored expected count.

cost_semantics: Same absolute20/55/60/90 and500/512MiB. Counter acquisition and saved serialization are charged; no clock reset or late-success. Whole caller/owner resource clocks remain authoritative; local sums are diagnostic, not resource acceptance.
